snippet.title: Lostbound - Trailer | Available now on Steam
snippet.description:
Find all the Artifacts before you’re caught in this Roguelite Action RPG. Embrace your destiny and escape a collapsing world. Darkness is alive. The Hand erases your path and drags you into the Abyss. Every step shapes your run.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4588320/Lostbound/?utm_source=lb_yt&utm_medium=trailer
